title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand

But Astra's capabilities are unlike anything before.

thread_text:
1. OpenAI Just Paused Pro

New Pro subscriptions are on hold. The reason: demand for its new Astra model blew past available capacity.

2. Astra Broke the System

This isn't a minor outage. OpenAI had to stop taking new Pro users entirely because the infrastructure couldn't handle the load.

3. Astra Isn't Like Other Models

Its capabilities are unlike anything before. That's exactly why so many people rushed to sign up at once.

4. No Access Right Now

If you want Astra, your only options are joining a waitlist or using alternatives until capacity catches up.

5. Check Your AI Plan Now

Open your current AI subscription and see if it covers what you actually need. Capacity won't wait for you to figure it out.
